problem: What is the trace in the $yz$-plane of the elliptic paraboloid $z=\frac{{x}^{2}}{8}+\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{27}.$
worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $yz$-plane, we substitute $x=0$ into the equation of the paraboloid, and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}z & =\frac{{0}^{2}}{8}+\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{27} \\ z & =\frac{1}{27}(y-1)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

 

This gives us the equation of the parabola in $yz$-plane.
